messages:
Rafael: Quick sync on RBAC UI tweaks. I pushed a new Figma frame (link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/RBAC-Invite-Flow). Main topics: roles matrix readability, invite flow ordering, SSO toggle copy, and audit-log filters being discoverable on desktop + mobile. Can people drop quick UX + a11y flags? Priya: Saw the frames. Roles matrix looks dense at 1200px width. Suggest reducing columns shown by default to essentials: Role name, scope, actions. Add a chevron to expand full capabilities. That reduces cognitive load for new org admins. Ellen: I worry about collapsing columns hiding important perms. If we collapse, add a spotlight tooltip on first visit explaining "hidden permissions can be expanded". Also keep a keyboard-accessible control (not hover only). Priya: Good call. Make the spotlight dismissible and remember preference in localStorage. For keyboard, use a visible toggle button with aria-pressed. Rafael: Invite flow: current modal puts role selector after you add emails. Users often miss it. Propose reordering: (1) Role selector + optional message, (2) email entry, (3) preview + send. Keeps assignment explicit before action. Liam: Agree. Also for bulk invites we should show estimated costs/limits: e.g., "Youre inviting 250 users. This will consume X license seats." That prevents surprise. Add a passive warning if invites > 1000 with async processing note. Ellen: Accessibility notes: ensure email input supports paste of newline-separated lists and announces count via aria-live. Example: "
12 addresses parsed
". Focus order must land on Send button after parsing so keyboard users can confirm. Priya: SSO toggle language: current "Enforce SSO for org" might be misread. Alternatives: "Require SSO sign-in for everyone" or "Require SSO for organization". We should include a short inline explanation: "Disables password sign-ins; existing sessions may be invalidated." Legal to confirm session behavior. Rafael: For audit log navigation: moving time-range presets to the header is promising. Also add a persistent breadcrumb-like filter bar that condenses on narrow screens. Allow permalinks to specific query results. Liam: Implementation detail: encode filters as query params like `?user=alice@example.com&event=token.rotate&range=7d`. Back/forward behavior must restore table state incl. sort and cursor. Ellen: Microcopy: change role label "Viewer" to "Read-only" in UI, but keep alias mapping in backend so API tokens remain unchanged. Add hover help: "Read-only: can view org resources but cannot edit." Priya: Touch targets: info icons in the matrix are currently 28px; increase to 44px for mobile. Also popovers should be dismissible by Escape and by tapping the backdrop. Rafael: Analytics events request: `rbac.roles_expand`, `invite.reorder_confirm`, `audit.filter_share`. Include properties: role_count, invite_count, filter_query. DevOpsBot: Deployment note: feature flag `rbac_new_matrix_v1` created. Rollout segments: 10% internal, then ramp 25/50/100 over 2 weeks. Liam: Let's add an A/B text test for the SSO label: test A="Require SSO sign-in" vs B="Require organization-wide SSO" and measure clicks to toggle + support tickets. Rafael: Action items: Priya to update Figma with collapsed-columns variant + mobile condensing; Ellen to add a11y checklist items to the test plan; Liam to spec URL query params and permalinks; I'll create a ticket for the invite reorder and role label change. Target: ship design handoff Thursday. Ellen: Leaving comments on Figma for aria-live snippets and keyboard flow. Priya: Will mock up the spotlight onboarding for first-time admins. Rafael: Thanks team 44d 4b84dd.
